title: Year 4 spelling test: -ation, -sion, -tion, -ssion and -cian (20 words)
subject: English
source: Written for english/y4 lesson 82 (Year 4 spelling test (20 words: -ation, -sion, -tion, -ssion and -cian; printable or in the portal))
intro: Lesson 82. Your teacher reads each word and a sentence. Write the word. Think about the root: t or te gives -tion; d, de or se gives -sion; ss or mit gives -ssion; c gives -cian (a person).

blocks.answers: 1 invention; 2 action; 3 creation; 4 information; 5 education; 6 extension; 7 confusion; 8 division; 9 television; 10 explosion; 11 discussion; 12 permission; 13 admission; 14 expression; 15 electrician; 16 musician; 17 magician; 18 optician; 19 station; 20 decoration

blocks.note: Teacher reads: 1 invent → invention; 2 act → action; 3 create → creation; 4 inform → information; 5 educate → education; 6 extend → extension; 7 confuse → confusion; 8 divide → division; 9 television; 10 explode → explosion; 11 discuss → discussion; 12 permit → permission; 13 admit → admission; 14 express → expression; 15 electric → electrician; 16 music → musician; 17 magic → magician; 18 optic → optician; 19 station; 20 decorate → decoration.
